name: crypto-grid
title: Crypto Grid
description: A seven-tile payments bento on white — a purple hero over three partner coins stacked and zooming together, a ring of app tiles sweeping the top arc of a circle whose centre sits below the card, a QR plate riding half off the top edge, a floating report panel whose spend bar fills on wake, a field of glyphs quietly rewriting itself behind the secure card, a QR that gets scanned on hover and a bell that rings. Every tile lifts to the pointer; the whole board wakes when it scrolls into view.
